en.headline: Kai Tak smart green mass transit tender closes with two bids including MTR
en.dek: The government received submissions from the MTR Corporation and a consortium of Transport International and Sun Hung Kai Properties; the system is targeted for service in 2031.
body: The open tender for the Kai Tak Smart and Green Mass Transit System closed at noon on Friday. The government said it received two bids, including one from the MTR Corporation and another from Green Smart Rail Group, a joint venture of Transport International (parent of Kowloon Motor Bus) and Sun Hung Kai Properties.

The approximately 3.5-kilometre elevated system will run six stations linking the Kai Tak Cruise Terminal with MTR Kai Tak Station, serving the former runway area, Sky Garden, Sung Wong Toi Park and Kai Tak Sports Park. The project is the city’s first smart green mass transit system procured under a public-transport-oriented development model that grants the successful bidder property development rights on three nearby sites.

A government spokesman said the market response was positive and that teams with experience in railway construction, public transport operations and property development had participated. Evaluation under a dual-envelope system will begin immediately, with the contract targeted for award within the year and the system expected to open in 2031.

zh.headline: 啟德智慧綠色集體運輸系統截標 接獲包括港鐵兩份標書
zh.dek: 投標者包括港鐵，以及載通國際與新鴻基地產合資的綠色智軌集團；系統目標2031年投入服務。
body: 啟德智慧綠色集體運輸系統合約周五中午截標，政府表示共接獲兩份投標書，分別來自港鐵公司，以及由九巴母公司載通國際與新鴻基地產合資的綠色智軌集團有限公司。
項目全長約3.5公里，擬設六個高架車站，連接啟德郵輪碼頭與港鐵啟德站，途經啟德空中花園、承豐道公園及啟德體育園。這是本港首個以公開招標及「公共運輸引導發展」模式推展的智慧綠色集體運輸系統，中標者可獲附近三幅用地的物業發展權作為財務資助。
政府發言人指市場反應正面，吸引具備鐵路興建、公共運輸營運及物業發展經驗的企業參與。標書評審委員會將即時展開評標，目標於今年內批出合約，系統預計2031年竣工投入服務。
